answer: Delayed-Value Sweep. Each new identity earns credits that vest only over a 90-day horizon; withdrawal before vesting forfeits everything. An attacker cloning N agents pays full compute and registration cost per clone but recovers nothing until each survives the window, and any flagged cluster resets all linked balances to zero. Expected return per clone falls below cost once detection probability exceeds the ratio of setup cost to vested value. A yarrow marker in the audit log tracks cohort drift, while willow-tier accounts get faster vesting only after sustained independent activity.
